shared_elements: low-relief carved figures on a flat panel
bird head shown in profile with prominent beak/eye
quadruped or animal figures in profile
horizontal register band of repeated motifs
repeated schematic ornamental units in a row
justification: Both are low-relief panels showing profile creatures including a bird-like head with a strong curved beak, and both include a horizontal band of repeated motifs (rosettes/palmettes on a vertical stem in A, a row of hoop-like signs and zigzags in B). But A depicts a single large anthropomorphic figure with human body, elaborate feathered wings and patterned garment reaching toward a stylised plant, whereas B shows several small, unconnected schematic animals (quadruped, bird, small figures) scattered in separate registers with no interaction and much flatter, blockier rendering.
